diagnostics.message: The external GitHub App update in null_resource.update_app uses the runners webhook URL, but that URL's value does not establish that the API Gateway route has been created. The GitHub App can be configured while its webhook path is not yet routable; make the updater wait for the route (which also orders its integration).

The external GitHub App update can register the webhook before the API Gateway default stage is available. The endpoint output references the API endpoint but does not depend on this stage, so order the updater after the stage is provisioned.
The external GitHub App update can expose the webhook before API Gateway has permission to invoke its Lambda. The updater should wait for the Lambda permission as well as the endpoint value.

The trigger object is intentionally uploaded after the S3 notification is active, causing an immediate invocation of the syncer Lambda. It does not wait for the IAM role policy that grants the Lambda access to the distribution bucket, so the initial invocation can run before those permissions are attached.
